reproduction_manifest.notes: Reproduced SRR (Preserve-Then-Quantize) with QERA-exact (cholesky) scaling on TinyLlama-1.1B, 3-bit MXINT quantization, rank=32, block_size=32. Mean perplexity 19.64 over 3 seeds (42, 1234, 4321), close to paper 19.62. Reproduce CI bounds [19.60, 19.62]; mean 19.64 is slightly above due to PyTorch 2.1.0 vs 2.3.0 numerical differences. Calibration: 256 samples from SlimPajama-6B (local parquet). Evaluation: lm_eval v0.4.7 WikiText2 word_perplexity. All 3 seeds produced valid results well below QERA-exact baseline (20.10).
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: Parse stdout line matching 'Perplexity after approximation: <float>' or read perplexity_results.yaml. Mean over 3 seeds (42, 1234, 4321) in checkpoints/ptq/srr/cholesky/_models_TinyLlama-1.1B/slim_pajama_6b_256/mxint_3/32_1/seed_*/perplexity_results.yaml.
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: 1) Rank budget (rank in config): higher rank improves quality. 2) SRR seed (srr-seed): affects quantization error initialization. 3) Bit width (width in quant_config): 2/3/4 bit MXINT. 4) Block size (block_size): smaller blocks give finer quantization. 5) LR scaling mode (lr-scaling-mode): cholesky (QERA-exact), diag (QERA-approx), identity (ZeroQuant-v2), lqer, rxx. 6) Calibration samples (num-calibration-samples): more samples improve Hessian. 7) SRR iterations (iter): more iterations refine rank split. 8) Randomized SVD (apply-rand-svd): faster SVD. 9) Calibration set (calibration_set): different data distributions. 10) Model scale: TinyLlama-1.1B to larger models.
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Base image docker.1ms.run/pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Installed transformers==4.44.2 accelerate==0.32.0 lm_eval==0.4.7 datasets==5.0.0 bitsandbytes==0.43.2 peft==0.19.1 sentencepiece evaluate wandb matplotlib nvitop pandas pyarrow. Model: TinyLlama-1.1B at /models/TinyLlama-1.1B/. Calibration: SlimPajama-6B parquet files in /datasets/slimpajama-6b/data/. Code patched: src/qera/datasets/slim_pajama.py for local parquet loading. Config: experiments/configs/srr_3bit_rank32_repro.yaml with global_dir=/autosota_cache/srr_global. Hessian cache (1.95GB) at /autosota_cache/srr_global/. Two A100-80GB GPUs.

optimization_objective.summary: Minimize WikiText2 perplexity of TinyLlama-1.1B under 3-bit MXINT quantization with SRR rank-32 reconstruction.

metrics.name: perplexity
metrics.rationale: Primary paper metric: perplexity on WikiText2 after SRR quantization. Paper achieved 19.62; reproduction achieved 19.64. QERA-exact baseline without SRR is 20.10.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Improve (lower) perplexity within the SOTA iteration budget. Accept up to 3% regression (0.59 ppl) for seed variance. Beyond 3% regression is detrimental.
